title: Pearl Material Summary
text_faithful_view: Text-faithful view (faith interpretation): Revelation 21:21 describes each gate as a single pearl. The passage gives the material as pearl, not a nacre specification.
engineering_view: Engineering view: Natural pearl nacre is layered aragonite platelets in an organic matrix, with a refractive index around 1.53 to 1.68 depending on direction, which produces its characteristic lustre and orient. Those optical values are demonstrated for real nacre; a monumental single pearl is not an established material, so the summary separates what nacre is from what a gate can be built from.
body: Signature-original design: this record approximates the corresponding public record with Signature-original materials and detailing. Where any part of it is speculative it is labelled Signature-original, and it is never presented as an authentic public record. Nacre's strength comes from its brick-and-mortar microstructure: hard aragonite tablets bonded by a small fraction of organic material, giving toughness far above that of a single aragonite crystal. Engineered nacre-inspired materials copy that layering with ceramic platelets in a polymer or mineral matrix. The demo computes refraction at a nacre face from its mid-range index.

N = 1.58

crit = math.degrees(math.asin(1.0 / N))

print('Refractive index: %.2f' % N)
print('Incident angle: %.1f degrees' % INC)
print('Refracted angle: %.2f degrees' % refr)
print('Critical angle: %.2f degrees' % crit)

title: Gate Dimensions and Scale
text_faithful_view: Text-faithful view (faith interpretation): Revelation 21 gives no gate dimensions; the wall is 144 cubits in verse 17 and the city is 12,000 stadia in verse 16, but no gate height or width is stated. Any gate size is therefore a design choice, not a textual measurement.

At full visionary city scale the dimensions become a design-model question, because the city side itself is illustrative at about 2,220 kilometres.

title: Gate Assembly Sequence
text_faithful_view: Text-faithful view (faith interpretation): No assembly sequence is given in Revelation 21; the gates appear complete in the vision. Assembly belongs to the engineering programme.
engineering_view: Engineering view: A nacre-inspired panel gate is assembled in sequence: frame erection, substrate fixing, panel layout from the centre outward, joint sealing, pearlescent finish application, and final inspection. Each step is checked before the next begins, and panels are numbered so a damaged panel can be replaced with its matching spare.
body: Signature-original design: this record approximates the corresponding public record with Signature-original materials and detailing. Where any part of it is speculative it is labelled Signature-original, and it is never presented as an authentic public record. The sequence matters because the pearlescent finish must be applied after panels are fixed and sealed, or the finish will crack at the joints. Panels are laid from the centre of the gate outward so the pattern stays symmetric, and the last panels fitted are the edge trims. The demo totals the sequence time for a sample gate.
